prompt:
You are a scientific-replication judge. Evaluate whether an independent
reproduction on RefSeq NC_000913.3 (the current curation-updated reference for the same
E. coli K-12 MG1655 strain sequenced by Blattner et al.) supports the quantitative
claims of:

Blattner F. R. et al. (1997) "The complete genome sequence of Escherichia coli K-12."
Science 277(5331):1453-1462, doi:10.1126/science.277.5331.1453.

Paper claims (P) and our independently measured values (M):

| Claim | Paper (1997) | Measured (NC_000913.3) |
|---|---|---|
| Genome size | 4,639,221 bp | 4,641,652 bp |
| G+C content | 50.8% | 50.791% |
| Number of protein-coding genes (CDSs) | 4,288 | 4318 |
| Mean CDS length | ~950 bp (~317 aa) | 937.6 bp (~311.5 aa) |
| Coding density | ~88% | 86.32% |
| tRNA loci | ~86 | 86 |
| rRNA operons (16S loci) | 7 | 7 |
| Co-orientation of CDSs with replication | ~55% ("most genes") | 54.89% |
| Start-codon ATG (context) | (paper does not tabulate) | 90.16% |
| Start-codon GTG (context) | (paper does not tabulate) | 7.83% |
| Start-codon TTG (context) | (paper does not tabulate) | 1.85% |
| Whole-genome %A / %T / %G / %C | (implied from G+C=50.8%) | A=24.619 T=24.59 G=25.367 C=25.424 |

The reference sequence used is NC_000913.3, the current RefSeq record for the
same MG1655 strain sequenced by Blattner et al. It is 4,641,652 bp
(+2,431 bp / +0.052% vs. the 1997 sequence) due to ~28 years of curation-driven
error correction. The gene annotation reflects continued community curation
(EcoCyc, RegulonDB, RefSeq).

Please treat small numerical drift due to (a) post-1997 re-sequencing and (b)
CDS/tRNA annotation refinement as expected — the paper itself was known to be
an initial snapshot. The core question is whether the paper's whole-genome
quantitative *body* is honestly independently reproducible from free public data.

Return STRICT JSON with fields:
  verdict: one of REPLICATED, PARTIAL, SPOT-CHECK, NO-GO, CONTRADICTED, BLOCKED, FAILED
  coverage_pct: integer 0-100 (fraction of paper's testable quantitative claims we tested)
  agreement_pct: integer 0-100 (of tested claims, fraction that agree within reasonable tolerance)
  justification: 2-4 sentences

parsed.justification: Core genome-wide quantities (G+C content, tRNA count, rRNA operon count, and CDS co-orientation with replication) reproduce closely on NC_000913.3, consistent with expected minor drift from curation and resequencing. Genome size and protein-coding gene count differ modestly (≈0.05% longer; +30 CDSs), plausibly attributable to sequence error correction and annotation refinement rather than a failure of the original report. Coding density and mean CDS length are directionally consistent but show larger differences (≈1.7 percentage points and ≈1.3% shorter, respectively), suggesting annotation updates materially affect these derived metrics. Several listed measurements (start-codon usage and base composition breakdown) were not explicitly tabulated as claims in the 1997 paper, limiting claim-level coverage.
